digest_md:
## FPL 2026/27 Transfer Digest

- **Chelsea sign Lacroix (Palace)** – adds CB competition; Palace lose a defensive rock, denting their clean-sheet appeal.
- **Newcastle land Bamba (£34m, Monaco)** – attacking option to monitor; potential differential if he starts.
- **Newcastle closing on Kiernan (Liverpool)** – another forward; watch minutes before investing.
- **Summerville → Al-Hilal** – West Ham lose an attacking asset; frees up midfield roles.
- **Man Utd sign GK Leitzig (Leicester)** – backup keeper, unlikely FPL relevance unless he displaces Onana.
- **Arsenal sign GK Rodriguez (free)** – cover only, no FPL value.
- **Palace chasing Le Guen** – youth defender, one for the future.

**Takeaway:** Palace's defence weakens post-Lacroix; Newcastle strengthening attack — track Bamba and Kiernan for early minutes.
